acceptance: Each production call site passes the run's seed to the TPC-DS maintenance test; a test per call site asserts that a configured seed reaches the generator.
The exported result contains the maintenance seed; an export round-trip test asserts it.
With the same seed, two runs produce identical maintenance row sets; with different seeds, they differ (reuses the reproducibility test from #3960).
description:
Problem. tpcds-maintenance-timer-hygiene-20261103 (PR #3960) made the TPC-DS maintenance generator deterministic, with a configured seed, a fixed default, and the seed recorded in the maintenance result. The production callers (benchbox/platforms/base/execution.py, benchbox/core/tpcds/benchmark/runner.py and official_benchmark.py; re-read the symbols, since line numbers drift) pass no seed from the run, so every run uses the default. The result's seed is also dropped when results are exported. The oracle raised this as finding D2 on #3960. The owner withdrew it there as outside that item's scope and asked for this follow-up.

Change. Thread the run's seed (the same source the throughput and power streams use, if there is one; otherwise a documented run option) into the maintenance test at each production call site. Include the maintenance seed in the exported result.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree; no explanatory comments; durations unchanged; changelog.d fragment; deterministic runs use a seed (AGENTS.md); no live cloud.
